message:
test(dirretry r2, Codex T1/T2): stages read at one moment; the fixture caches only inside the test root

T1 -- the staged host's record was cycle n's but the fake directory's counters were whatever the loop had
reached by the time the test read them. A bounded barrier at the same loop boundary (test hooks only:
EnableCycleGateForTest / ReleaseCycleForTest) holds the agent after recording cycle n until the test
lets it go; StagedHost::Wait steps cycle by cycle and leaves the loop held at n. A timeout of the
barrier is a loud failure. Limited counter-cases: the inactive and cached-silent stages run a second
time with a 17 s slow observer (past cycle 4) -- same counts, the advertisement installed before the
next ask. A new mutant, NO_CYCLE_GATE, must fail: it fails exactly those slow passes (inactive-slow
reads 2 heartbeats at cycle 1, as Codex reproduced; cached-silent-slow's cycle 4 is told nothing).

T2 -- the caches lived beside the executable, i.e. outside the repository for a build under
C:/work, and the test deleted them there. Now REMOTE60_TEST_TMP must name one ASCII folder directly
under D:/remote/remote/.claude/test-tmp (the directory suite's rule); the anchor must exist and not be
a link, the folder is created one level in and must not be a link. Every cache path is built there and
the only delete refuses anything outside it. No valid root: the test does not run (exit 2).

Product: none (hook code is under REMOTE60_DIRECTORY_TEST_HOOKS, test targets only).
Tests: directory_retry_test, mutant target. Docs: in the report.
